name: projeto-tcc
description: NutriCare — monorepo com a API (NestJS), o app do paciente (Expo) e o painel da nutricionista (React).

scripts.instalar: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/mobile ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.verificar: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
